title: Task-irrelevant stimulus-content decoding
scientific_question: Can a task-specific decoder identify content from individual or label-independently aggregated observations in one fixed COGITATE experiment1 modality, stratified by task relevance?
primary_outputs: Content scores frozen before private label scoring. Category-specific test averaging belongs only to a separately named source-reproduction diagnostic, not candidate preprocessing.

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.
This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

allowed_inputs.proposed_scope: Expected source-specific input: one recording-bearing COGITATE experiment/modality plus content, duration, relevance/report labels; site/person linkage pending.
allowed_inputs.allowed_context_policy: Only target-permitted variables may enter the query; all this task targets, future variables, answer-bearing filenames and evaluation labels stay private. Encoding receives stimuli/history with training neural responses and hides query neural targets.

biological_unit: participant and acquisition site; modality cohorts must be mapped rather than presumed identical
case_definition: Proposed biological-unit/session packet with nested scored observations; exact eligible cases unknown until source audit.

split.policy: Freeze modality, phase, participant/site and task-relevance splits. Source within-person transfer does not establish new-person/site transfer. Declare training-only versus label-free transductive covariance separately from label-aware averaging.
split.uncertainty: Group at biological unit, with source-specific stimulus/block dependence; do not promote neuron/trial counts to independent animals.

reference.role: Pinned experiment1 MEG analysis source. Category-aware test pseudo-trials and transductive covariance are distinct from hidden-label prediction; sample-bundle ROI compatibility and reference execution remain unresolved.

common_policy.fixed_program: Freeze program and fitting/adaptation recipe before query access; any target-batch adaptation must be explicitly permitted.
common_policy.case_adaptive: Same allowed data, checkpoint tools, context batch and accounted compute; no evaluator labels/feedback; reset case state as specified.
common_policy.model_tools: Compare generic numerical tools, supplied decoder alone, and matched agent-plus-decoder arms. Record checkpoint training exposure and preparation cost.
common_policy.investigation: Require estimand, numeric artifacts, uncertainty, alternative explanations and executable evidence; independent scorer verifies them.

observable_endpoints.definition: Participant-macro balanced accuracy with task-relevance strata.

evaluation.comparability: Distinct assignment within a shared task family/source; no new dataset/cohort claimed for paradigms, modalities or file versions.

unresolved_grading.requirement: Freeze exact sample eligibility, target definition, primary metric, split, access rules and resource budget before outcomes.

resources.basis: Unmeasured estimate. Use bounded existing derivatives/reference features; full-source procurement and model training are not implied.

holds.requirement: Obtain permitted public bundle access; choose one compatible experiment/recording cohort and exact label schema.

Count this umbrella once, not per modality, format or experiment. Experiment 1 supports the 2025 paper and linked code; 2026 experiment 2 requires a separate compatibility audit. Decoding alone cannot adjudicate full consciousness theories. Source audit only; not execution-qualified.
Retrieve bounded versioned manifests/schema and verify actual recording inputs, labels, alignment and biological identity; catalog identity alone is insufficient.

Implement and run data adapter/evaluator/reference, matched controls and malformed-output tests; independently reproduce results before any validation claim.

construction_gates: Resolve approved source access and benchmark-use/redistribution conditions; no account or terms acceptance performed.
Select experiment1 and one modality/analysis; verify exact participant files, phase, source version, timing and inclusion before payload acquisition.
Acquire a bounded permitted recording/derivative sample and inspect actual schema, channels, events and calibrated measurements; declared FIF fields are code expectations only.

Build a category-hidden, single-trial or explicitly declared aggregate prediction reference. Do not group evaluation observations by hidden true labels; original pseudo-trial results are not a directly matched prediction baseline.
Freeze participant/site/stimulus grouping, any target-person calibration, source estimation/transductive access, seeds, metric, time windows and nuisance controls.
For temporal claims, distinguish source-space smoothing/filtering, stimulus duration/offset and task relevance; unsuccessful decoding does not establish absent conscious content.
Reconcile archived published-code version with current commit and intended inverse regularization; dependencies/preprocessing are not executed.
Treat the processed MEG alternative as overlapping evidence with PAPER-paper-method-add-010 and qualify its narrower input/target bridge separately.

next_implementation_action: Resolve access and a category-hidden prediction interface; true-label pseudo-trial averages are not a matched single-trial predictor.
